preregistered_net_rule: Choose using IS only. Among eligible candidates maximize the WORST midrank of four criteria: higher weaker-half Sharpe, higher weaker-half CAGR, smaller absolute half-Sharpe gap, smaller absolute half-CAGR gap. Rank among the full 30-arm grid. Tie by mean of these four ranks, weaker-half Sharpe, lower turnover, then lexical ID. No later gap enters selection. Positive net CAGR in each IS half, whole-IS CAGR at least the greater of BIL CAGR and expanded 6/4 CAGR minus 0.5pp, IS drawdown at most 2pp worse than expanded 6/4, positive IS CAGR with its three biggest IS risky contributors set to cash, positive IS CAGR at 20bp and one extra session. If none qualifies, identify the score leader as diagnostic only and preserve the failed search.
